facts.text: I am looking for information on European Union coins.
I have been trying to complete my set of European Union coins.
I am curious to know which countries have released commemorative coins in the past few years.
I got a 2018 Greek 2-euro coin from a local coin shop.
The 2018 Greek 2-euro coin was the last one I needed to complete my EU set.
I am interested in learning more about the designs and mintages of these coins.
I want to know more about the design of the 2018 Greek 2-euro coin I just got.
I want to know how many were minted of the 2018 Greek 2-euro coin.
I am interested in learning more about the mintage of other EU commemorative coins.
I want to know which country has issued the lowest mintage of a 2-euro commemorative coin in recent years.
I didn't know that the Maltese Temples of Mnajdra coin had such a low mintage.
I have been thinking of expanding my collection to include more coins from smaller EU countries.
I want to know what the design is like on the 2015 Luxembourg 2-euro coin commemorating the 15th anniversary of the accession to the throne of Grand Duke Henri.
I want to know whether the 2015 Luxembourg 2-euro coin design is unique or follows a common theme.
I have been thinking of adding more coins from the Benelux countries to my collection.
I want to know which commemorative coins Belgium has released in recent years.
I think I will start by looking into the Belgian coins.
I am especially interested in the 2018 2-euro coin commemorating the 50th anniversary of the May 1968 student and worker protests.
I want to know if there are any online marketplaces or coin shops where I can find the Belgian 2018 2-euro coin.
